guest_notify.en: Thank you! I've forwarded your message to our landlord Jay. He'll be in touch shortly — Ramli 🏠
guest_notify.ms: Terima kasih! Saya telah maklumkan kepada tuan rumah kami. Beliau akan menghubungi anda tidak lama lagi — Ramli 🏠
guest_notify.zh: 谢谢！我已将您的信息转达给我们的房东 Jay，他会尽快与您联系 — Ramli 🏠

emergency_guest.en: I've immediately alerted our landlord Jay about your emergency. He will contact you as soon as possible. If it's life-threatening, please call 999. — Ramli 🏠
emergency_guest.ms: Saya telah segera memberitahu tuan rumah kami Jay tentang kecemasan anda. Beliau akan menghubungi anda secepat mungkin. Jika mengancam nyawa, sila hubungi 999. — Ramli 🏠
